name: The Saffron Palm Hotel, Dubai Marina

info.check_in_out: Check-in is from 3 PM and check-out is by 12 noon. Late check-out until 4 PM is 200 AED, subject to availability.
info.breakfast: Breakfast is served at Saffron Kitchen on the ground floor, 6:30 to 10:30 AM, 95 AED per adult, children under 6 eat free.
info.pool: The infinity pool is on the rooftop, level 21, open 7 AM to 10 PM. Towels are provided.
info.spa: Palm Spa is on level 2, open 10 AM to 10 PM. Guests get 15 percent off treatments; booking ahead is recommended.
info.wifi: Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel. Network SaffronPalm-Guest, password is your room number and surname.
info.parking: Valet parking is free for hotel guests. Self-parking is in basement levels B1 and B2.
info.airport_transfer: Private airport transfer from DXB is 250 AED per car each way, about 35 minutes. Please give us your flight number a day ahead.
info.metro: The nearest stop is DMCC Metro station on the Red Line, a 7 minute walk. The Dubai Marina tram stop is 3 minutes away.
